perItemFindings.one_line: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.

verbatim_critique:
[D0.5.G cold referee] delivered tier=incremental below novelty_target=field (floor=field). The note proves an exact ATE identified interval for its maintained common-binary-confounder class, including interior endpoint attainment, a one-arc optimization reduction, and a certified strict gap from its own separate-pair relaxation. Its significance is limited by the absence of any proved translation to an established sensitivity model: the numerical tightening is against an internally constructed relaxation, so it does not establish improvement over a procedure practitioners currently use. The semialgebraic certificate and atlas are mathematical termination results rather than a reproducible implementation with demonstrated computational behavior, which weakens the applied case. The advertised inference contribution is only pointwise on a unique smooth active branch; uniform inference at the branch switches and degeneracies emphasized by the tipping atlas remains open, precluding a stronger frontier claim. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]

HALTED AT TRIAGE: the math panel returned `revise` and its findings were never repaired, so this note is NOT established as mathematically sound — do not bank it as downgraded on this verdict alone. Open findings: undeclared-dependency@thm:complete-semialgebraic-certificate, undeclared-dependency@thm:strict-common-u-tightening, undeclared-dependency@thm:zero-tipping-atlas, related_work_incomplete@thm:sharp-common-u-envelope, ballast@prop:rr-bounded-union
